dedupe_keys.name: long term heat demand scenarios under climate change utilising a stochastic dynamic building stock model morphed hourly outdoor temperatures for jyvaskyla for 2030 and 2050

description: Jari Pulkkinen and Jean-Nicolas Louis at the University of Oulu publish morphed hourly outdoor temperatures for building heat-demand simulations in Jyväskylä, Finland. The November 2020 deposit contains fifty CSV series, covering full years for 2030 and 2050, with temperature in degrees Celsius. Its README distinguishes five baseline weather choices, global and regional climate-model sources, and RCP2.6, RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 where available. The files are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. They support comparison of heating scenarios under alternative future weather assumptions. These are transformed climate scenarios, not observed future temperatures, and uncertainty depends on the selected baseline and climate model. Related catalogue record data-climate-onebuilding-tmyx-weather-files covers one upstream baseline collection, not these morphed series. The public README was read; individual time series and the associated manuscript were not checked.
